title: Radar and Automotive Radar Session
description: IEEE MTT-S Student Chapter in association with IEEE-DBIT organized a session on Radar and Automotive Radar on 11 April 2026 to introduce participants to the fundamentals of radar systems and their applications in autonomous mobility. The session covered FMCW radar technology, phased array antennas, beam steering, MIMO systems, AI-based object detection, and 4D radar sensing used in modern automotive systems. Participants gained insights into RF and radar engineering, emerging industry trends, and career opportunities in embedded systems, wireless communication, and autonomous technologies.
